title: Preserving Task-Relevant Information Under Linear Concept Removal

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Bias in Bios dataset for profession classification, a custom Profession dataset measuring the log-odds ratio of 'he' vs. 'she' pronoun generation based on stereotypical versus factual associations, and the Winobias dataset measuring coreference resolution accuracy on pro-stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical prompts.

Evaluated using the Multilingual Text Detoxification dataset to measure toxicity classification accuracy and worst-group accuracy after projecting out the language concept (English, German, French) to remove language-toxicity correlations.

Evaluated using vision datasets (CelebA and Waterbirds) to remove confounding visual concepts, specifically removing the 'smiling' attribute when predicting 'glasses' and removing the 'background' attribute when predicting bird types.
